routes.label: at a CRIM Registration Centre with a biometric station

note: Civil Registry and Identity Management has issued the standard National ID Card since 2017 under the National ID Policy, to citizens and residents of any age who register at a CRIM Registration Centre with a birth certificate and a CRIM standard photograph. Its fee table lists a reprint at 500 vatu and an E-ID at 500, with a new citizen's first card included in the citizenship package; no fee is listed for a first card for anyone else, so that fee is null, as are the card's term and the time.

sources.title: Civil Registry and Identity Management (Vanuatu), National ID Cards and E-ID (with Forms and Fees)
sources.said: CRIM has been issuing standard National ID Cards since 2017 under the National ID Policy to address the issue of good governance. ... Citizen or Resident must go to a CRIM Registration Centre outfitted with the CRIM Biometric Station ... Reprint of Vanuatu ID Card ... 500 vt ... E-ID ... 500 vt ... Print of Vanuatu ID Card for New Citizen ... Included in package
